principles.title: Mathematical rigor meets operational reality
principles.description: A model that achieves 99% accuracy on a static test set is useless if it degrades silently under real-world non-stationary distribution shifts.

principles.title: Zero training-serving skew
principles.description: Offline training features and online streaming features must share identical schema contracts, unit tests, and transform definitions.

principles.title: Latency is a core product feature
principles.description: In production, an inference model that breaches SLA latency bounds is indistinguishable from a total system failure.

principles.title: Continuous observability over blind faith
principles.description: Live prediction distributions, input feature drift, memory pressure, and p99 percentiles must be monitored with automated circuit breakers.
